records.claim: Miscarriage is common and can occur in any pregnancy for many different reasons. Taking mycophenolate in pregnancy can increase the chance of miscarriage. One report suggests the chance for miscarriage with mycophenolate use during pregnancy may be close to 50% (1 in every 2 pregnancies). Since some of the conditions that mycophenolate is used to treat can also increase the chance of miscarriage, it is hard to know if the medication, the medical condition, or other factors are the cause of a miscarriage.
